---
title: Python examples
engine: knitr
---

These focused examples execute when the documentation is built. Their downloads
contain the exact source displayed here, not a separate maintained copy.

- [Script executor](script-executor/index.qmd): execute a file-backed function.
- [Dagclass](dagclass/index.qmd): bind a parameter to a class-based computation.
- [Multi-file report](analysis-report/index.qmd): keep calculation and recording
  in separate modules, with individual files and a path-preserving ZIP bundle.

Start with [installation and initialization](../getting-started.qmd), then
configure a writable [remote](../use/reference/configuration.qmd). These examples
need Python and DaggerML; they do not require Docker or SSH. The documentation
build supplies disposable storage, but downloads do not provision services or
configure credentials for you. Run a downloaded entrypoint from your initialized
project directory, with its storage endpoint configured.

The repository's shell-oriented push/pull, Docker, and SSH workflows remain
separate from this embedded collection.
